meta.parties: De Silva v. Rosinahamy Et Al

rules.statement: A mortgage of an undivided share is protected by section 12 of the Partition Ordinance, even if not disclosed in a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think it follows from these sections that any mortgage, which has not been excluded in consequence of a finding in the partition case, must be regarded as having force and effect in spite of the partition or sale."
